source_title: How Us State Sales Tax And Fees Applies To Etsy Orders

snippets.snippet_text: "Etsy is required by the state of Colorado to charge buyers an additional 29 cent fee for orders of physical goods shipped to addresses within the state of Colorado. The fee is not charged for sales of digital goods. Etsy collects this fee from the buyer for each applicable order at checkout and remits it to the Colorado Department of Revenue."
